label: DeepSeek V4.1 Flash 1017
output:
Tolu, good evening. I saw your post and I had to reply because I’m literally you one year ago. I’m Amaka_Bio100, I’m in Biology 100L now. Last year I scored 251 in JAMB, applied for Medicine and Surgery, and the portal gave me Biology. Federal uni here in Lagos. So when you say you want somebody inside Biology 100L that wanted Medicine, that person is me.

I’m not going to lie to you and say “accept it, everything will be fine,” and I’m not going to lie to you and say “rewrite, Biology is useless.” Both are lazy answers. I’ll tell you what I know, what I was told, and what I’m still facing.

The day I saw Biology on my portal, I locked myself in my cousin’s room in Surulere and cried. I didn’t eat that day. My mum was still telling people in church that I’m doing Medicine for like two months after, and I had to beg her to stop. So I know that crying-since-afternoon feeling. It’s not small. But after the crying, you need facts, because this decision will affect at least one year of your life.

Now the transfer gist. Our level adviser told us that to transfer to MBBS after 100L, you need a CGPA of at least 4.5 out of 5 AND there must be space. Both. Not just 4.5. Space. She said last year about 6 people got moved in from the whole faculty, and she thinks over 40 applied. I’m repeating what she said, not swearing to it, but that ratio alone should tell you transfer is not automatic. She also said you need the Medicine cut-offs in JAMB and post-UTME too. I don’t know your school’s cut-offs or your post-UTME score. You scored 268, fine, but 268 alone does not establish eligibility. You have to check both. Every school is different. Please go to your faculty or department and ask for the exact transfer rules for your own school. Don’t just trust forum people, including me. I’m one year ahead of you, not an admissions officer.

My own CGPA after first semester is 4.31. Not 4.5. I’m still trying. So I’m not speaking from outside. I want the transfer, but I’m not sitting down banking on it like it’s guaranteed. That’s why I can’t tell you “just accept Biology and transfer” as if it’s buy-one-get-one. It’s real, but it is not easy.

For 100L, the courses we’re doing are BIO 101, CHM 101, PHY 101, MTH 101 and GST. Physics and maths are the ones dealing with people. For practicals, lab coat was 6,500 naira, dissecting kit was 9k, and the practical manual is extra. Small money, but it adds up if you weren’t planning for it. First BIO practical we dissected toads. One guy in my group fainted. I was fine. That day I realised I actually like this thing. I’m enjoying genetics and cell biology more than I expected. So Biology is not a bad course. It’s just not Medicine. If your mind is on clinical work, Biology 100L won’t satisfy that by itself.

But hear me well: Biology is not a “dead” course either. I’m not going to pretend it’s Medicine, but it’s not rubbish. The problem is people accept Biology when what they actually want is MBBS, then they’re miserable for four years. That’s the real issue, not the course itself.

About rewriting. My secondary school classmate Ifeoma rejected a Pharmacy offer to rewrite for Medicine. She has written JAMB two more times and she’s still at home. That doesn’t mean rewriting is evil. It just means it’s not a magic wand. Staying home is not as easy as people say. Favour is right about that part. You’ll see your mates going to school and it can mess with your head. But Favour’s “just read hard in 100L” is too simple, because even if you read hard and get 4.5, there must still be space, and you must meet the JAMB and post-UTME cut-offs. Kingsley saying transfer is a myth is not true. People do move. But it’s also not the automatic thing some people make it sound like. So both of them are half-right and half-wrong.

Use these two weeks before the acceptance fee deadline to ask questions, not just cry. Call or visit your faculty. Ask: does your school even allow Biology to MBBS transfer? What CGPA last year? How many slots? How many people applied? Do they consider JAMB and post-UTME cut-offs? What’s the exact process and deadline? Ask 200L and 300L students who have tried it. Get real information for your school, because my school’s rules may not be your school’s rules.

And ask yourself one hard question: do you want Medicine, or do you just want to be called “doctor” for your parents and church people? No shame, it’s a real question. If it’s Medicine because you love it, then plan properly. If it’s pressure, don’t destroy yourself for a title.

Whatever you choose, it’s not the end of the world. If you accept Biology, go in with your eyes open and work for the transfer, but don’t think it’s automatic. If you rewrite, do it because you’re ready to sit at home and read again, not because your aunty said it. You’re 19. You have time, but time is not something to waste either. Just don’t let fear make the decision for you. You’ll be okay. Reply here if you want to ask me anything else.

— Amaka_Bio100
